newsitem.title: FRANCE: Michelin to retire convertible bonds early.
newsitem.headline: Michelin to retire convertible bonds early.

text.p: Tyremaker Michelin said in a financial advertisement that it would retire its 2.50 percent convertible bonds maturing on January 1, 2001, ahead of schedule on March 21, 1997.

The bonds will be redeemed at 274.80 francs plus 2.97 francs in outstanding interest for a total of 277.77 francs for bonds with nominal value of 255 francs. The total number of bonds in circulation had a nominal value of 3.49 billion francs.
On February 12, 1997, the conversion parity was 1.01 B shares for each convertible bond, it said in an financial advertisement in the French newspaper Les Echos.
